get_wikitext2_train_samples: get wikitext-2 training samples as random sequence chunks for model training
get_wikitext2_eval_data: get wikitext-2 test data tokenized as a single tensor for evaluation
create_CustomJsonDataset: create a PyTorch IterableDataset that tokenizes and groups JSON text data into fixed-size blocks
tokenize_function: tokenize a text example using the dataset's configured tokenizer
group_texts: concatenate tokenized examples and split them into chunks of a specified block size
